summary: M0 model-only verdict: ESCALATE @ 1.00. All sign-ins for g.sen@aegean.edu are consistent: one known device (dev-gs-phone), one city (Manisa, TR), two known IPs (Superonline mobile and AS-AEGEAN-EDU university), stable daily cadence across lms/mail, no impossible travel, no new devices, no MFA anomalies, no failed-auth bursts — so there is no confirmed account takeover (not "contain"). However, the user received and clicked a phishing link (edevlet-burs-basvuru.com, KYK scholarship lure) at 2026-10-15 13:10, shortly before a normal LMS login. The logs show no follow-on compromise but cannot rule out credential harvesting on the phishing site. This is confirmed exposure with insufficient evidence to close, requiring human investigation (password reset, mail forwarding/rule check, phishing-page intake) — not benign and stronger than a weak monitor signal.
limitations: M0 ablation: Nemotron alone, no tools, no Critic, no Risk Gate, no DQ. Not a product configuration.
